scene_id.Description: Fan-transcript scene index the gap falls in

onset.Description: Gap time: end of the turn before the gap, relative to episode start. Mapping to fMRI run time / TRs is the consumer's responsibility.

block_distance.Description: Cosine distance between mean-pooled w-turn blocks on either side of the gap; continuous topic-shift regressor. Higher = larger semantic shift.

depth.Description: TextTiling depth (rise above neighboring valleys) at local maxima of block_distance; NaN at non-maxima.

is_peak.Description: Gap accepted as a boundary by the topic-shift detector at the recorded params. NOTE: the detector is a documented negative result (docs/scene_segmentation_evaluation.md, Prototype #2); is_peak is an audit trail, not a validated boundary.

w.Description: Block half-width in turns used to compute block_distance and is_peak.

min_spacing.Description: Minimum seconds between accepted peaks (greedy, deepest-first).
